content: 'In 2024, Xander Schauffele from America earned a historic $3.1 million (£2.3 million) from a prize pool of $17 million (£12.6 million) by triumphing at Royal Troon.'
'The American golfer Xander Schauffele, who triumphed at Royal Troon in Scotland in 2024, is the reigning champion of The Open.'
